name: inspect_rust_binary
description: Inspect the cargo-auditable crate dependency list embedded in an explicit local ELF, PE or thin Mach-O image. Returns the artifact SHA-256, the .dep-v0 section file offset and size, compressed and uncompressed sizes, format version, packages in their original order, the root package index, and dependency edges by index. Omitted or explicit complete detail preserves the full report. Optional detail summary retains that complete Evidence and returns source ranges, counts and parent_evidence_id. Optional view directly selects packages or edges in this call; it cannot be combined with explicit complete detail. Query the same retained facts with inspect_analysis_view kind rust: exact names/versions or package indices, edge from_indices/to_indices, fields and matching-row pagination. Row indices are original and scoped to the parent Evidence; empty filters select none. Default package fields omit dependency vectors; explicitly select dependencies for direct index references. Every matching observed version is retained. No current runtime state is inferred from historical reads. Reads zlib-compressed JSON without installing Rust, opening a disassembler, executing the target, writing temporary files or accessing the network. A missing section is null metadata with a limitation and is not proof that the binary has no dependencies. A rustc commit hash is reported only as an inference when a /rustc/<40-hex>/ path is present in read-only data. Resource guards bound files to 256 MiB, dependency sections to 1 MiB, inflated JSON to the smaller of 8 MiB and 64 times the compressed size, and the complete report to 8 MiB. Malformed, unsupported and oversized inputs receive typed failures rather than partial success.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the selected executable or library

fields.description: Original index always retained. Default attributes omit dependency vectors; select dependencies explicitly for direct index references.
